# Brief buttons

Each open item gets one button. The button href is https://chat.example.com/new?q={urlencoded seed}&mode=mini and nothing else.

One render per brief · each item is re-read through its own tool, never pasted · every button href is exactly https://chat.example.com/new?q={urlencoded seed}&mode=mini — that or none.
